name: Ougi Daichi
source:
Daichi is a 22-year old [url=https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/freeter]freeter[/url] who is a friend of Kei. Skilled at making conversation, he is an excellent moodmaker who is great at creating a lively atmosphere. He is very friendly and can get along well with anyone, to the point of being overly familiar.  He is a fantastic communicator, listener and smooth talker who is unmatched at entertaining others. He can also get along reasonably well with those of differing personalities and interests. Great at socializing, he is ready to even spend the night out if invited.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/101imoutokanojo/]official website[/url]]
